items.title: 68252_Jay Cee
items.q: Yes, Bubber Miley, yes, he was a trumpet player.

ctx.x: In one of the little things I read about him, he told how a trumpet player, Bubber Miley? Does that ring a bell with you?
Yes, Bubber Miley, yes, he was a trumpet player.
And he used a plunger at the end of his trumpet to get some fantastic sounds.
